brief.idea: In Moldova, a seven-day trail running week on marked mountain, forest or coastal trails. Carta has no trail running trip in Moldova yet, so choose the strongest route the country offers for it.

In Moldova, a seven-day paddling, sailing or swimming week on the coast or a lake. Carta has no water sports trip in Moldova yet, so choose the strongest route the country offers for it. Only a reduced form of this trip type fits here (Prut and Dniester only, no coast); say so plainly in the trip rather than stretching it.
